ValidationRule.description: Annual and Refreshment leave are locked during probation. Sick and statutory leave are not blocked - Thai law mandates paid sick leave. Scoped to saves that create or reshape the request, so it cannot block unrelated edits to historical records.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName <> "Overtime_Request", OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Request_Type__c), ISCHANGED(Term_From__c), ISCHANGED(Term_To__c), ISCHANGED(Status__c) ), OR( ISPICKVAL(Request_Type__c, "Annual leave"), ISPICKVAL(Request_Type__c, "Refresh Leave") ), NOT(ISBLANK(Owner:User.Probation_End_Date__c)), Term_From__c <= Owner:User.Probation_End_Date__c )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Annual and Refreshment leave are not available during the probation period. Accrued leave becomes available once probation is complete.
